Full independent review and fresh final delta approve `503f5beed4db53b643694dcb95f46db1c9ebb6a9`, with no remaining actionable findings.

The initial read-only pass found normalized-response and inherited-default warning gaps; the single corrective read-only delta confirmed both fixed. Independent full review then verified the shared path policy, canonical/missing/symlink containment, credential/config denials, dynamic config, warning behavior and optional request correlation, with 86 focused tests passing. The final correction updates only a wire-roster comment and two denial assertions; a fresh reviewer reran all 113 tests, confirmed no runtime change and inspected the policy-bypass RED proof. Final-head feature/repro smoke passed, with the unchanged runtime digest tying it to the previous complete SDK/Haiku/reply/switch flow. Local baseline failures are explicit in the description. Hosted CI and posted-review triage remain delivery gates.

Closing this unmerged attempt for the next bounded trial wave. Final-head Windows CI found six allowed-path assertions failing because native asynchronous resolution expands short paths while synchronous policy boundaries retain their spelling. The exact head and review/CI evidence are retained; the fresh retry will use consistent native canonicalization and must pass the real Windows suite.
